summary: Add What's Working: is Threads dead? It checks every post you published this year against your own median views, labels each dead, stuck or alive, answers month by month, names what Threads is killing and the one kind of post it still pushes hardest with your real posts as proof, charts it on a local report page, then Threadify writes three posts in that pattern, each with a tracked Auto Plug, scheduled only after one exact yes Every workflow now follows shared demo feedback rules (ask once, keep going between approved steps, phone-readable output, real numbers only, Threadify's copy untouched) and reads the owner's private ~/.threadify/owner-overlay.md when present, without ever publishing it
